segments.he: ופ"א אמר מהרנ"ת ז"ל את הכל אני יכול לתאר לי רק את הלילה הראשונה בקבר את זה איני יכול לתאר לי (אלדינג קען איך מיר אוס מאלין נאור דוא ערשטי נאכט אין קבר ניט בעם ערשטין ברוך הבא).
segments.en: And the holy Rav of Avritch commanded Reb Shmuel to be a mohel [circumcisor] — and so he became the general mohel for all the surrounding area. Once he performed a circumcision and created an open urethra — and the boy urinated in drops. Reb Shmuel had a grievance with the Rav of Avritch — for he had commanded him to be a mohel. The Rav answered: "Do not fear — he will have a complete healing before his wedding." Many years passed and they saw the boy still urinating in drops. At the time of his wedding they came to the Rav of Avritch and asked if they should hold the wedding. He said yes. And on the day of the wedding ceremony the boy was completely healed — and was like any person and had children and so forth.
